session.title: Stumpjumper 2K climb repeats (3 fixed + optional 2K+)
session.purpose: Use today's confirmed green readiness and Garmin ACWR 0.8 OPTIMAL for a controlled Kiara XC-style repeatability block: stabilize climb power, cruise down cleanly, and preserve Friday/Saturday trail quality.

dose.terrain: Known 2K climb-return loop with repeated ascent and descent to trailhead
dose.optional_repeat: one 2K+ only if repeat three stays clean

lap_template.reference_laps_from_2026_05_27: 2K descents were laps 2, 4, and 6; 2K+ was lap 8.
lap_template.climb: same return climb to trailhead; build controlled XC-style repeatability rather than one-off PR chasing.
lap_template.climb_target: Use power as the main governor: first climb 180-190 W average, second climb 190-200 W, third climb 195-205 W only if breathing and technique stay controlled.
lap_template.descent: 2K cruise on the chosen line with smooth body position, clean braking, and no segment chasing.
lap_template.2k_plus: slightly more technical 2K+ with roots, loose-sand switchbacks, and a short chunky chute.

climb_power_progression: repeat_3: 195-205 W average only if repeat two stayed controlled
dose.cap: Do not exceed 4 total descents; no session extension beyond this plan.
dose.recovery_between_repeats: RPE reset and full-sentence breathing before each next repeat.

session.adaptation_hypothesis: Using today's known green state should buy the XC-quality adaptation while creating more buffer before Friday Dinding and Saturday PCP than waiting until Wednesday.
execution_rules: Run the three 2K climb-return repeats cleanly first; only attempt 2K+ if repeat three stayed controlled.
Climbs are the work; descents are smooth cruise and skill-quality checks.
Judge the session by repeatable climb power plus descent calmness, not by forcing a one-off 5-minute climb.
Use Stumpjumper speed only when line confidence is clear; prioritize control over seconds.
Track 2K and 2K+ loop quality as technical score, not max pace.

expected_result.garmin_load: moderate MTB load with limited mission creep
expected_result.rpe: hard but controlled on final required climb
expected_result.next_day: manageable readiness and enough buffer for Thursday Sepang, Friday Dinding, and Saturday PCP.

stop_rules: No 2K+ if the third climb feels forced or the third descent is less clean than the first.
Stop immediately for upper-body fatigue that degrades braking timing or line choice.
Stop on sharp pain, repeated misses, wet-root risk escalation, or near-miss.
If total elapsed time approaches 2 hours, end the ride even if motivation is high.
